messages:
Alex: Quick heads up — I'm prototyping an SLO card annotation that shows the on-call/contact matrix and notification preferences. Want API shape + rollout thoughts. :eyes:
Marta: Love it. We should keep the annotation layer opt-in per-tenant. Minimal fields: contact_ids, primary_contact, notify_channels, escalation_policy_id. :+1:
Sam: Telemetry question: will the console surface which notification actually fired (email/sms/pagerduty)? We need that for noise analysis.
Kim: If we add that, we should also show whether it was suppressed by quiet windows or sampling — otherwise people will blame infra for 'not alerting'. :thinking_face:
Alex: Good point. Plan: surface last-notify-method and last-notify-reason in the UI. For rollout, default to read-only view, admin toggle to edit contact matrix.
Marta: API sketch (very rough):
```json
POST /v1/tenants/:id/slo-annotations
{
  "slo_id": "slo-abc",
  "primary_contact": "marta@redwood.com",
  "contacts": ["marta@redwood.com","ops@redwood.com"],
  "notify_channels": ["email","pd"],
  "show_last_notify": true
}
```
Alex: That looks fine. Two notes: 1) contact identity should be canonicalized to user-id so we can map to profile links; 2) put permissions behind SLO-edit scope.
Sam: For telemetry, add these events: notify.sent, notify.suppressed, notify.fallback. Each should include slo_id, tenant_id, method, reason. That will let us compute noise vs delivery.
Kim: Also include a boolean for `auto_routed` - so we know if the console routed to fallback tier vs primary contact.
Alex: Agree. Ops-bot: deploy-preview ready for annotation-service v0.1 — cluster staging-b.
ops-bot: deploy ops/annotation-service v0.1 -> staging-b succeeded in 02m 14s :rocket:
Marta: UX nit — in the card, show a compact badge for last-notify-method (e.g., PD, email) and a tooltip for last-notify-reason. That keeps density high.
Alex: Rollout plan: 1) backend API & telemetry only (read-only console) for 2 weeks, 2) opt-in per-tenant edit, 3) default admin enable after 30d if no major issues.
Sam: One more: rate-limit the annotation update endpoint to prevent noisy churn from automation. Maybe 1 update per SLO per minute, with admin override.
Marta: Yep. Also add an audit log entry for changes — who edited contact matrix and which fields changed.
Kim: Okay, blockers? I need to know how this interacts with quiet windows stored on the tenant-level vs route-level. If there's ambiguity, UI should call out precedence.
Alex: Noted — we'll surface precedence in the card and link to the routing debug view.
Marta: I'll draft an RFC and include sample telemetry schemas.
Alex: Thanks — please @ me when RFC ready. :thumbsup:
